content.title: Sponsors and Partners
content.summary: Majestic View Nature Center, the City of Arvada's environmental educational facility, relies on various sponsors and partners for funding and support, including the City of Arvada, the Scientific & Cultural Facilities District, and the Denver Broncos. These contributions help facilitate programs that reach over 12,000 school children annually and fund projects such as a new classroom and safety updates, with funds expected to be utilized by 2025. The Nature Center encourages community involvement and welcomes additional sponsorship to further its mission of promoting environmental learning.
content.body:
While Majestic View Nature Center is the City of Arvada’s environmental educational facility, our programming and Nature Center wouldn’t be possible without our other sponsors. The gifts of grants and one-time donations to environmental learning continues to help us reach our mission to inspire environmental learning and interpretive connections with our community.

## $10,000+

### [City of Arvada](//arvadaco.gov/)

In addition to the Nature Center, the City of Arvada's Vibrant Communities and Neighborhoods includes parks and sports fields, golf courses,  trails and open space, and much more.

The majority of the Nature Center is funded by the City of Arvada as approved through the City Council budgeting process.

### [Scientific & Cultural Facilities District (SCFD)](https://www.scfd.org)

The SCFD is a seven-county tax district created within Colorado law, approved by Colorado’s General Assembly and renewed by voters multiple times over more than 30 years.

SCFD funds school field trips and programs that allow Majestic View Nature Center to reach over 12,000 school children each year. To learn more about SCFD, [visit the SCFD website](https://www.scfd.org).

### Denver Broncos (Sale of)

The sale of the team to the Walton-Penner group provided the City with funds towards “youth activities”. With Council approval, the funds allocated to the Nature Center will go toward projects outlined in the masterplan and strategic recommendations, including a new classroom and accessibility/safety updates. Funds are expected to be used by 2025.

### [Jefferson County Open Space (JCOS)](//www.jeffco.us/open-space)

Majestic View Park was purchased in thanks to JCOS.

Funded with a one-half of one percent sales tax, Jeffco Open Space contributes to city and park district projects, has preserved more than 56,000 acres, and manages 27 open space parks and more than 244 miles of trails in Jefferson County, Colorado.

### Perkins & Will (P&W)

Perkins & Will (P&W) knows design has the power to inspire joy, uplift lives, and strengthen the spirit of community. So with the help of their design services, P&W helped create an amazing conceptual design for the new classroom.

## $5,000-10,000

### Colorado Garden Foundation

[Colorado Garden Foundation](//www.coloradogardenfoundation.org) provides grants and scholarships throughout Colorado to further the horticulture industry. Funds are raised with the Colorado Garden and Home show and the Fall Home Show.

## $1,000-5,000

### [Arvada Sunrise Rotary](//arvadasunriserotary.org)

Arvada Sunrise Rotary has sponsored new interpretive exhibits and park amenities, including our 2022 Bullsnake ambassador exhibit. The Arvada Sunrise Rotary focuses on service above self.

### Individual Donors

Aside from volunteer time donated, the Nature Center is eligible to receive charitable donations. If you are able and willing, you can give monetary donations for programs or program supplies. Your support ensures that we will continue to be able to work towards our mission and is greatly appreciated!

### [Jeffco Open Space Foundation (JCOSF)](//jeffcoopenspacefoundation.org)

Supporting conservation and stewardship of public lands and connecting people to the great outdoors in Jefferson County with amenities, programs and events and information. JCOSF helps sponsor costs for low-income/Title 1 schools to attend field trips and connect kids with the outdoors.

## Interested in Sponsoring the Nature Center?

If you or your group would like to sponsor the Nature Center, please [contact us](/1233/About) or [send us an email](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#f598949f9086819c96839c90829b96b5948783949194db9a8792). We appreciate all sponsors who help us inspire environmental learning and interpretive connections with our community. Curious about what you could help us achieve? Take a look at our original park master plan and our 2022 Strategic Recommendations for future plans and ideas.
